draft_en.body:
Hi, Inam,

In October 2024 you asked for a sample of the 4-port industrial PoE (STI-154GP) and we answered with the 36 USD price and the paid-sample rule. Nothing since, and our later mails went to a general mailbox, so this is the first one addressed to you.

Current price: STI-154GP — $51.7 USD EXW list (2026-10 price table, valid 15 days from this mail); samples are paid, credited against the first order.

One question: is a 4-port industrial PoE still relevant for a current site, or has the need moved to 8/16 ports?

Thank you.
Alan
